title: Gradiented control-plane rollout automation for private VPC clusters
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: build a repeatable, IaC-driven pipeline that performs safe, gradated (percentage-based) control-plane version upgrades across customer VPC/private clusters. The pipeline must be operable by SREs and Solutions Engineers for on-prem and VPC customers, integrate with Terraform modules, and provide automated health gating, traffic weighting, and fast rollback paths.

Scope:
- Terraform module changes to enable per-cluster upgrade metadata and canary weighting.
- A controller (stateless job) that orchestrates percent-based traffic shifts and coordinates rolling upgrades of control-plane services.
- Health checks and alert rules that serve as automated gates for progressing or aborting a rollout.
- Runbook and rollback automation (terraform rollback plan + emergency kill-switch).

Out of scope for this ticket: model-serving GPU node upgrades, tenant-level application upgrades, and changes to hosted API routing logic outside private control planes.
acceptance_criteria: A Terraform module (modules/controlplane_upgrade) accepts variables: target_version, initial_weight_pct, step_size_pct, step_interval_minutes, and canaries list, and applies upgrade annotations without manual state edits.
Orchestration job can perform a rollout that shifts traffic in increments (e.g., 0%, 5%, 25%, 60%, 100%) and stops automatically if any configured health gate trips.
Health gates: control-plane error-rate, avg p99 request latency, node readiness churn — implemented as alert rules and evaluated by the orchestrator via Prometheus API.
Rollback can be triggered automatically after N consecutive failing gates or manually from Console; Terraform plan for rollback is produced and can be applied non-interactively.
Runbook and one-click console actions documented and validated in staging with a simulated control-plane cluster.
End-to-end integration tests in the infra CI pipeline that run a simulated percentage rollout and validate gate behavior and rollback execution.
plan_steps: Design Terraform module API: variables, outputs, and tagging for rollout controller (blockers: cross-account state?).
Prototype controller as Kubernetes CronJob in staging that reads desired rollout spec from a Module-generated ConfigMap and calls Prometheus/Console APIs.
Add canary metadata to control-plane resources (Deployment annotations + labels) via Terraform and support dual-version selection during rollout.
Implement health gate evaluator that runs PromQL checks and returns pass/fail with confidence windows (3/5 samples).
Wire controller to Terraform via: generate rollback plan, apply progressive changes with short waits, and store rollout state in S3/remote state blob for resilience.
Create observability dashboards for rollout progress and add console buttons for pause/abort/force-complete.
Run staging exercises and capture timing, false-positive rates; iterate on gate thresholds and step intervals.
Ship RFC and runbook, then schedule pilot with two low-risk private customers before broader enablement.
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Dry-run: controller validates Terraform plan and runs health gate queries against baseline telemetry; no traffic change.
Phase 1 - Shadow: route 1-2% of synthetic traffic to target version (no customer traffic impacted); observe metrics for 30m.
Phase 2 - Canary: shift 5-10% of real traffic to new control-plane version for 60m with strict gates.
Phase 3 - Ramp: increase to 25-60% over multiple intervals, monitor errors and latency; enable human approval checkpoint at 60%.
Phase 4 - Cutover: 100% traffic on new version and decommission old version after stabilization window.
Emergency - Abort/Rollback: automatic rollback when N gates fail or manual abort via console invoking terraform rollback plan and apply.
terraform_changes: Summary of planned code changes: add modules/controlplane_upgrade/ with variables (target_version, canaries, weight_map, step_interval_minutes, auto_rollback) and a new resource type 'redwood_controlplane_rollout' that emits a ConfigMap in cluster_state bucket. Modify modules/controlplane_base to include 'canary_label' and 'version_label' on control-plane deployments. Add new outputs: rollout_manifest_bucket, rollback_plan_s3_key. Add a small helper CLI (go) used by CI to render a terraform workspace containing the rollback plan and to store apply metadata.
